i18n.i18nString: Limit riaditeľa — faktúry a objednávky (€ s DPH)
Nad túto sumu podpisuje úver ešte riaditeľ, aj keď ho kalkulačka alebo referent schválili.
Nad túto sumu schvaľuje po stredisku ešte riaditeľ. Platí rovnako pre došlé faktúry aj objednávky.
Kto schvaľuje faktúry a objednávky tohto strediska.

data.title: Director's limit - invoices and orders (EUR incl. VAT)
data.desc: Above this amount the director approves after the cost centre. Applies to incoming invoices and purchase orders alike.

data.title: Director's limit - loans (EUR)
data.desc: Above this amount a loan is signed off by the director as well, even when the calculator or the loan officer approved it.
